description:
Privacy-first local dictation for Windows. Powered by whisper.cpp with no cloud audio path.

VoiceWave is a privacy-first desktop dictation app that captures speech locally, transcribes it with on-device whisper.cpp models, and inserts text reliably into the focused app.

- Local-only transcription (no audio leaves your device)
- Global hotkey push-to-talk and toggle dictation
- Direct insert with clipboard and history fallbacks
- Verified model lifecycle with checksum validation
Dictation on your graphics card, better accuracy at the start and end of what you say, and a smoother first run.

### New

• **Dictation runs on your graphics card.** On PCs with a dedicated graphics card, VoiceWave now transcribes on the GPU through Vulkan, using the driver you already have; there is nothing extra to download. The Models page shows where dictation runs ("Running on …"), and the new **GPU acceleration** setting can be set to Auto or Off.
• **One-time graphics card check.** The first time the GPU is used, VoiceWave runs a short check (about a minute) before relying on it. The check runs again only after a graphics driver or speech-engine update. Onboarding shows its progress, and a dictation made during the check waits for it instead of running slowly on the processor.
• Existing users with a suitable graphics card get a one-time offer to switch to the GPU model.

### Fixed

• **First and last words are no longer clipped.** The recording kept too little audio before the first word, so short words at the start were misheard ("Restart" became "Please start"). It now keeps half a second on each side.
• Dictionary words no longer force their capitalisation on ordinary words："Things" stays "things" mid-sentence. Names and terms with inner capitals or punctuation (VoiceWave, Claude Code, T-Rex) are still corrected.
• A stuck graphics card is detected within seconds, and the dictation is retried once on a fresh GPU worker. After repeated failures VoiceWave uses the processor for five minutes, then tries the GPU again.
• Dictating with no speech model installed now says so right away.
• Model downloads can be cancelled one at a time, and onboarding can always be finished.
• Complete model files already on disk are picked up at launch instead of downloaded again.

### Changed

• If the graphics card can't be used and the active model is slow on your processor, the home screen offers Small for processors (465 MB). It takes over on the processor automatically, and your model returns to the GPU when it can.
• The optional CUDA add-on has been removed; GPU dictation no longer needs it.
